# Solr OSGi

> Embeds Apache Solr inside an OSGi container (Apache Karaf), providing dynamic Solr core and configset management through OSGi services with in-memory configset storage.

Key facts:
- Java 11 (source/target), Java 21 for Karaf assembly runtime
- Maven 3.9.4 multi-module project, 6 modules (+ parent POM)
- Apache Solr 7.0.1 embedded in Apache Karaf 4.4.7 via OSGi
- In-memory filesystem (Google JimFS) for configset storage — zero disk I/O
- OSGi Declarative Services for component lifecycle
- Apache License 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, architecture diagrams, installation, and usage
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, module descriptions, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and contribution guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD pipeline documentation with flow diagrams

## Modules — Core

- [solr-osgi-services/pom.xml](solr-osgi-services/pom.xml): Core OSGi bundle managing the Solr CoreContainer, configset bundle tracking, core configuration tracking, and core lifecycle
- [solr-osgi-http/pom.xml](solr-osgi-http/pom.xml): HTTP bundle registering Solr endpoints via OSGi HTTP Whiteboard — dispatch filter, static resources, admin UI, and Restlet schema API

## Modules — Packaging & Distribution

- [solr-osgi-feature/pom.xml](solr-osgi-feature/pom.xml): Karaf feature descriptor generation aggregating all runtime bundles
- [solr-osgi-karaf/pom.xml](solr-osgi-karaf/pom.xml): Pre-built offline Karaf distribution with Solr features pre-installed

## Modules — Examples

- [solr-osgi-example-configsets-exampleCollection/pom.xml](solr-osgi-example-configsets-exampleCollection/pom.xml): Minimal Solr configset bundle demonstrating the Solr-Configset manifest header pattern
- [solr-osgi-example-configsets-dataimportNorthwind/pom.xml](solr-osgi-example-configsets-dataimportNorthwind/pom.xml): DataImport handler example using MySQL Northwind database

## Depends on

- [osgi-utils](../osgi-utils): OSGi utility library — lifecycle tracking, config monitoring, ranked services

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): CI/CD build pipeline
- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Parent POM with version properties and dependency management
